report:
**Verdict — unit 1 first.** Smallest correct seam is the write-once structural review receipt; successor admission is unit 2. Bundling is wrong shape if it makes `reconcile` write, resets `workerTotal`, or adds a mutable head.

**Caller.** One explicit operator command in `tools/isswf-job.mjs`: `successor --action receipt|admit --runs-store S --attempt-id A001|A002 --grant-file G`. Ordinary `read|reconcile` stay read-only. No new module, registry, or daemon.

**Data — append-only, write-once.**
1. `<S>/<A001>/recovery-review-receipt.json` (`receipt` only, after live recomputation still yields `stopped-review-required` with unchanged pins): `{version, attemptId, taskSha256, targetBase, changedPaths, candidateHashes, protectedCheckCommand, jobPins, reviewRef, createdAt}`.
2. `<S>/successors/<hash(['job-successor-v1', admissionKey, predecessorAttemptId])>.json` (`admit`, claimed before preparation): `{predecessor:{attemptId, receiptSha256}, successorAttemptId, newInputSha, newBaseTreeSha256 (recovered typed tree), grantRef, workerTotal:N, providerInvocation:'uncertain', reviewRef}`.
3. Existing `admissions/<key>.json`, A001 directory, claims, records are never modified, listed, or released. No per-key head pointer.

**Gate.** Successor admits only if: predecessor recomputes to `stopped-review-required` (never terminal success/failure, live, or general unknown/model resume); receipt exists and hash-matches recomputed candidateHashes; successor `targetBase` Git tree blob sha256 and exec modes equal the receipted tree exactly; original pins/protectedCheckCommand carried unchanged (drift blocks); grant names predecessor, receiptSha256, newInputSha, reviewRef, and explicit `workerTotal:N` (no default; original 1 never reset; first admissions keep workerTotal=1); no effect `submitted.json` without matching `outcome.json`. Missing/changed receipt blocks. Prior provider invocation stays visible as `uncertain` — not reconciled, billing unknown. No auto-release/retry; same-ID repeats still refuse.

**Acceptance (offline fixture, no GH/provider; shape after verify-recovery-68-admission + native host-loss).** After host-loss yields `stopped-review-required`: A002 refused with no `.prepare-*`, no binding; receipt refuses on missing/mismatched grant or changed candidate; matching grant publishes once, replays byte-identical; successor with matching receipt + equal committed tree + explicit N admits while A001 bytes/pins/claims stay hash-identical; second edge for same predecessor, terminal and general-unknown cases refuse; submitted-without-outcome refuses.

**Scope.** One fixed private store, local-only; existing guide sentence plus machine fixtures, no new docs/framework. Mixed old-runtime/cross-store ownership remains external; no whole-#67, S04, or OPS-04..06 closure claimed; design only, no source implementation or provider/GitHub grant.
